name: SpanishModelVariant388_HandleRequest
evidence: matching spanish_model_variant/variant388_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4; a non-negative request builds the tube, arms, sheets, feedback rings and spokes from the 0x24-byte command record at data + 0xFC, otherwise it tracks the slot parts and runs the petal, sheet, ribbon-fan, strip and feedback helpers behind their start-frame and phase gates; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md, notes/overlays/spanish-model-variant388-entry.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the US and Japanese header-371 images build the same source through model_variant/variant371_entry.c, which selects CLUT x 512 instead of 640, and bind the helpers and the data (0x3C lower) at their own addresses. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
